spatulate.definition: Spatula-like fingertips and a palm broad at the wrist or finger bases.

philosophic.definition: Long angular hand,bony fingers,developed joints and long nails.

conic.definition: Medium hand with tapering palm,fingers full at base and slightly pointed tips.

psychic.definition: Long narrow hand with slender tapering fingers and long almond nails.

mixed.definition: No single base type,with fingers of different types; not merely square palm with mixed fingers.

mars_active.location: below Jupiter inside Life line,next to Venus

mars_passive.location: outer palm between Mercury and Luna

luna.location: outer lower palm,opposite Venus and below passive Mars

line_definitions.life: Curves around the thumb-base Mount of Venus.
line_definitions.head: Crosses the middle of the palm.
line_definitions.heart: Crosses the upper palm beneath finger bases; source origin is at Jupiter/Saturn side.

conventions.hand_use: pp77-78: inspect both hands; left natural/inherited context,right acquired/training context. Left-handed clarity noted but no explicit automatic side reversal; dominance recorded only.
conventions.observations: Manual qualitative observations only. Unknown/uncertain never treated as confirmed. No invented numeric classification thresholds.
conventions.conflicts: Opposing symbolic indications retained without averaging or a composite personality score; different hands compared as observed differences only.
conventions.exceptions: p74:no single adverse mark decisive; p87:Head slope depends on hand type; pp43-44:mixed types modified by palm foundation/strong Head line. Unsupported refinements explicitly withheld.
